outcome: Successful medical management (defined as management without the need for aspiration)
cohort: 90 patients who received mifepristone-misoprostol for early pregnancy loss at an academic center-based clinic from May 2018 to May 2021
finding: Medical management of early pregnancy loss with mifepristone and misoprostol was successful in 76 (95% CI 82.9%–96.0%) of 85 patients (89.4%) with follow-up.
gest_age: Median ultrasound-measured gestational size of 49 (range 30–80) days
